summary: First-pass full-stack testing of Chinnaswamy Academy MVP. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests passed against external preview URL (health, auth cookies, login/me/logout, admin auth guard, grounds, slots, bookings double-book 409, slot occupancy update, admin bookings PATCH/DELETE, admissions CRUD, attendance mark/get, blogs CRUD public+admin, contact, stats). Frontend: Homepage loads with all sections (About/Facilities/Grounds/Programs/Timings/Pricing/Gallery/Blog/Contact); 4 seeded blog cards visible; Book Ground modal opens with 2-step flow (ground+date+slot then details), grounds and slots render with prices and availability; Admin login at /admin/login authenticates and redirects to /admin; all 5 sidebar tabs (Overview, Bookings, Admissions, Attendance, Blog Mgmt) render; Admissions create persists; Blog Mgmt create persists; Approve/Reject buttons present in Bookings tab.

minor.issue: allow_origins=os.environ.get('CORS_ORIGINS', '*').split(',') combined with allow_credentials=True. Browsers reject '*' + credentials. Works only because frontend and backend share the same preview origin (k8s ingress). Set CORS_ORIGINS explicitly to the frontend URL for production.
secure=False on set_cookie. In production over HTTPS, set secure=True and samesite='none' for cross-site safety.

issues: Uses native browser <input type="date"> instead of shadcn Calendar/Date Picker component. Inconsistent with dark/lime theme and varies by browser.
Document title is still default 'Emergent | Fullstack App' instead of an academy-branded title (e.g., 'Chinnaswamy Academy Marsur').

action_items: Replace native HTML date input in BookingModal with shadcn Calendar/DatePicker for visual consistency.
Set CORS_ORIGINS in /app/backend/.env to the explicit frontend URL (avoid '*' with credentials).
When deploying behind HTTPS, switch auth cookies to secure=True, samesite='none'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); prefer FastAPI lifespan context manager (FastAPI >=0.93).
All admin endpoints rely on get_current_user but do not verify role=='admin'. A non-admin user (if any created later) could access admin endpoints. Add a role check helper.
set_auth_cookies sets secure=False, fine for local but must be configurable via env for prod HTTPS.
CORS allow_origins default '*' with allow_credentials=True is an invalid combination per browsers — needs explicit origin list.
Bookings have no soft-delete; admin DELETE is hard delete. Consider keeping audit/history.
seed_data_creation: All test data prefixed TEST_ and cleaned up via pytest fixture teardown (booking) and admin DELETE endpoints. UI test left one TEST_UI_Student admission and one TEST_UI_Blog blog in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run: pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. All endpoints, auth, and slot-occupancy logic verified. Frontend booking modal date input is a native HTML input (id selector: input[type='date']). Admin dashboard tabs are direct buttons in left sidebar (no role='tab'). Use selectors button:has-text('Bookings'), etc. To clean leftover UI seed data: log in as admin and delete TEST_UI_* entries in Admissions and Blog Mgmt tabs.
rca of the issue: No bugs found — MVP is functional end-to-end.
